note: The thirteen node types and how the directory groups each one. Order here is the order on the front page.

entries.name: The vine
entries.blurb: Pinot noir and the family it mutates into: meunier, gris, blanc, précoce.

entries.name: Regions
entries.blurb: Appellations, AVAs, valleys and communes — the ground pinot noir answers to.

entries.name: Vineyards
entries.blurb: Named sites: grands crus, climats, benchland blocks, a hillside somebody fenced.

entries.name: Cellars
entries.blurb: Domaines, wineries and tasting rooms — who presses the fruit, and who lets you in.

entries.name: Clones
entries.blurb: Dijon numbers, suitcase cuttings, field selections. The vine is a copy of a copy.

entries.name: Vineyard and cellar
entries.blurb: Whole cluster, cold soak, punch-down, neutral oak, the decisions that show up in the glass.

entries.name: At the table
entries.blurb: Tri-tip over red oak, duck, salmon, mushrooms, a hard cheese and a cold cellar.

entries.name: People
entries.blurb: Growers, winemakers, nurserymen, scientists, the writers who argued about it.

entries.name: Organizations
entries.blurb: Appellation bodies, growers' associations, nurseries, archives.

entries.name: Events
entries.blurb: Auctions, celebrations, barrel tastings, the weekend a valley opens its doors.

entries.name: Words
entries.blurb: Climat, lieu-dit, saignée, brix — each one with its root.

entries.name: Art
entries.blurb: Labels, posters, harvest photographs, the pictures the trade prints of itself.

entries.name: Stories
entries.blurb: Long reads: how the grape travelled, what a vintage did, what goes on the grill.
